The main takeaway from our work is that
the nonlinear optical equalization capabilities of photonic reservoirs are not only limited to metro optical communication links, but also extend to the high speed short reach links.
nonlinear equalizers based on silicon photonical reservoirs can be used to combat nonlinear impairments in optical communication links, both in metro and short reach links.

optical information processing based on silicon photonically implemented reservoir computing can be used to compensate for nonlinearities that arise in both metro and short reach optical links, thus enabling the development of low cost, high performance, low energy consumption, optical equalizers for future high speed communications.
